name: Incident Propagation & Cross-Domain Operational Impact Verification

planSteps.description: Create an active HIGH severity incident referencing an AVAILABLE location
Invoke POST /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/propagate
Verify location propagation returns APPLIED with action RESTRICT_LOCATION and resulting_state RESTRICTED
Create a CRITICAL severity incident referencing an AVAILABLE location
Invoke POST /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/propagate
Verify location propagation returns APPLIED with action ISOLATE_LOCATION and resulting_state INACCESSIBLE
Create a LOW severity incident referencing an AVAILABLE location and trigger propagation
Verify location propagation returns SKIPPED with reason indicating LOW severity does not restrict locations
Attach an AVAILABLE asset to a HIGH severity incident and trigger propagation
Verify asset propagation returns APPLIED with action MAINTENANCE_ASSET and resulting_state MAINTENANCE
Attach an AVAILABLE asset to a CRITICAL severity incident and trigger propagation
Verify asset propagation returns APPLIED with action QUARANTINE_ASSET and resulting_state QUARANTINED
Attach an available inventory stock lot to a HIGH severity incident and trigger propagation
Verify inventory propagation returns APPLIED with action QUARANTINE_STOCK, reduces available stock, and appends a QUARANTINE ledger transaction
Trigger propagation again on the same incident referencing the quarantined stock lot
Verify idempotent propagation returns SKIPPED without creating duplicate quarantine transactions
Attach a cargo consignment to an active incident and trigger propagation
Verify cargo reference returns REQUIRES_OPERATOR_ACTION without artificial status mutation
Attach a transport leg with explicit delay metadata (new_estimated_arrival_at) and trigger propagation
Verify transport leg returns APPLIED with action DELAY_TRANSPORT and resulting_state DELAYED
Attach a transport leg without explicit delay metadata and trigger propagation
Verify transport leg returns REQUIRES_OPERATOR_ACTION with reason requiring explicit ETA or delay duration
Attach an unsupported reference type to an incident and trigger propagation
Verify propagation returns NOT_SUPPORTED without crashing the request
Attach a RETIRED asset to an active incident and trigger propagation
Verify propagation returns REJECTED in accordance with terminal state invariants
Attempt POST /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/propagate on a CLOSED incident
Verify HTTP 409 Conflict is returned and no downstream mutations occur
Create a multi-reference incident with mixed targets (valid location, retired asset, cargo) and trigger propagation
Verify response summary reports mixed outcomes: APPLIED, REJECTED, and REQUIRES_OPERATOR_ACTION
Invoke GET /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/propagation
Verify historical propagation records are retrieved with matching statuses and operational metadata
